Name: Map Teleport
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is just a simple mod that allows for fast travel from one part of the world to another.

To use, simply open up the map menu, hover over a map label and left click on a label. Simple!

The trigger button can be changed to any key in the config.json file created when the mod first runs.

Since warp points are tied to the map coordinates, I can only guarantee full compatibility with the vanilla game. Most warp points work with Stardew Valley Expanded, but if you use an alternate farm, the farm warp point might be off.

You can change the map coordinates by editing the [b]coordinates.json[/b] file in the mod's folder with a text editor.


[size=4][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
